summary: Pins @hivemagnus/ardent 3.1.4 (@hono/node-server 2.1.6 or later); the Ardent management API, generated client and node-agent allowlists are unchanged. The server no longer validates the retired, unused SECURITY_FUSION_RECEIPT_SIGNING_KEY; a leftover value, like the other retired Security Fusion local-mode settings, is ignored at startup. No migrations, new settings, browser contract or protocol changes.
